root.label: Iran culture minister said ministry compiled list of distinguished Iranians abroad

events.label: Iran culture minister said ministry compiled list of distinguished Iranians abroad

slots.name: list size
slots.sentence: On August 27, Abbas Salehi, Iran's minister of culture and Islamic guidance, said in an interview with the prominent Iranian media outlet Farhikhtegan that his ministry had compiled a list containing the names of more than 100 distinguished Iranians living abroad.
